Principal Architect / Tech Lead
InMobi
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (On-site)

About InMobi:
InMobi powers intelligent advertising solutions reaching over 2 billion devices globally.

Role:
• Define system design, distributed systems architecture, and scalability standards.
• Modernize big-data event pipelines processing billions of ad events daily.
• Guide engineering teams on Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, and AWS infrastructure.

Requirements:
• 7+ years of hardcore backend and architecture experience.
• Tier-1 college only (IIT / BITS Pilani alumni required).
• Mastery over distributed systems, algorithms, concurrency, and high-performance databases.
